title: Jambo 20' Extra Long Triple Lane Slip Splash and Slide- with 3 Body Boards
features: 💧 EXTRA LONG VERSION OF OUR BEST-SELLING SLIDE: Our Triple Lane Slip Splash and Slide is such a hit, we decided to bring you another even longer version of it! With 20' of sliding, kids can make countless wonderful memories sliding down the Extra Long Triple Lane Slip Splash and Slide!

💧 MORE LANES FOR MORE FUN: Our wide, three- lane water slide gives kids a way funner sliding experience, where they get the chance to splash around and slide at once for hours and hours of water fun! Less time spent waiting around for a turn- and more time spent sliding and having an awesome time with family and friends. Three kids can slide at once with our blow-up water park. They can have races to see who’s faster, splash around or show off new tricks they learned on the boogie board.

💧 LONG-LASTING, PREMIUM DESIGN: We researched and tested other slides to see how we could make improvements. Our lawn tarp slide is made from thick, industrial-grade .22mm PVC that is much stronger than most lawn water slides on the market. Roll it up and pack it away at the end of summer. It will be ready to go year after year!

💧 PERFECT SPRINKLER SYSTEM, PERFECT FUN. PATENT-PENDING DESIGN: There are sprinkler holes all around both sides of the slide that are specially designed to give maximum wetness, for maximum wheee! This amazing backyard toy has great water coverage over the whole slide, which will keep kids sliding fast, and eager to soak up the water fun!

💧 INCLUDES 3 BODY BOARDS TO SLIDE & RIDE ON: Not all waterslides are created equal! Most water slides only come with the slide and no other accessories. Don’t settle for that! Body boards provide a much more fun sliding experience. Jambo includes them for you, so that you don't have to spend extra money getting the slide accessories you want & need. You deserve the best. Our brilliant slip and slide waterslide pad comes with three bodyboards to ride on! A whole lot of backyard toys all in one!
